claim: Bounded local workflow audit; not a universal compatibility certification.

areas.claude: Shared CLAUDE.md is the project rules entry point. Native review additionally receives the full task contract.
areas.codex: AGENTS.md points to CLAUDE.md. Live readonly exec actually read both and returned the required rules.
areas.operator_action: Read CLAUDE.md and docs/process.md before acting; AGENTS.md stays a pointer.

areas.claude: Repository skills are in .claude/skills. Older model-choice prose has drifted.
areas.codex: No repository .agents/skills entries: use the explicitly documented manual reading of .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; no automatic Claude slash commands.
areas.operator_action: Use available native tools and the shared process; read the named skill manually. Do not pretend its Claude-only tool syntax exists. Model-selection prose needs #270.
areas.alternative_or_limit: Read the existing Claude skill manually; automatic Codex skill discovery is not provided here.

areas.claude: Claude Agent calls and profiles are available only in a Claude session that exposes them.
areas.codex: This main Codex session implements directly in its isolated worktree; no Claude Agent tool is assumed.
areas.operator_action: Honor the owner-selected implementer and reviewer. An available tool is not permission to spawn extra implementers.
areas.alternative_or_limit: Use the owner-selected main session directly when the other client’s agent tool is unavailable.

areas.claude: Use an isolated implementer/reviewer worktree. Native Claude reviews retain their own tree.
areas.codex: The main session created task/T61-client-compatibility in .claude/worktrees/T61-client-compatibility. Live smoke confirms the own-worktree rule.
areas.operator_action: Create a dedicated branch/worktree; never stash or clean another session. A sandbox may need approval to create sibling worktrees.

areas.claude: Agent profiles have hooks; the native CLI backend uses trusted generated settings and a hook for Read/Grep/Glob plus native Bash permissions.
areas.codex: Claude hooks and agent grants do not load into Codex. Its actual sandbox/approvals apply. A sandbox-denied systemctl check worked after explicit host escalation in T60.
areas.operator_action: Use the actual client permissions; never bypass them to imitate another client. Tests inherit the required memory cap. Native Bash safeguards are not an OS sandbox.
areas.alternative_or_limit: Use Codex’s own sandbox and approval flow; Claude hooks are not imported into it.

areas.claude: HARNESS_CLIENT=claude preserves endpoint-based detection even with inherited Codex markers.
areas.codex: CODEX_THREAD_ID/CODEX_SESSION_ID or HARNESS_CLIENT=codex identify OpenAI. CODEX_HOME alone does not.
areas.operator_action: Set HARNESS_CLIENT to the actual orchestrator for detached jobs. Never falsify HARNESS_SESSION_FAMILY to evade an old filter.

areas.claude: Installed CLI 2.1.292 exposes noninteractive output/effort/settings options. The native review below is the live Claude check, not this preflight.
areas.codex: Installed CLI 0.163.0 supports read-only exec, JSON events, ephemeral mode and output schemas; live read-only smoke completed.
areas.operator_action: Use run-unit.sh with closed stdin and 6G cap, one watch.sh monitor, and retained output. SSH on this host does not require desktop forwarding.

areas.claude: Native Claude can be observed using its stdout.jsonl file through peek.sh. This is exercised by the owner-selected review, not inferred from a version string.
areas.codex: OpenCode export for the previous live MiniMax session exits zero with malformed JSON; peek.sh fails although watch.sh SQLite progress remains usable.
areas.operator_action: Use watch.sh --opencode-log plus a targeted read-only SQLite final query under rule 25 for this known failure; never rerun a healthy model merely because peek failed. Do not use the export helper as a required gate until #261 is fixed.
areas.alternative_or_limit: Use watch.sh SQLite progress and the targeted read-only final query when OpenCode export is malformed.

areas.claude: CLI version/help works; auth status was checked separately in T60. Catalogue availability is not an authenticated review. Exact native identity is verified on every actual run.
areas.codex: codex login status reported ChatGPT login; the bounded exec call actually completed. No auth/config contents were read.
areas.operator_action: Discover exact model IDs live where supported; distinguish discovery from an actual successful call. Cloud startup incorrectly equates model listings with login (#271).
areas.alternative_or_limit: Only a successful authorized call establishes usability; a catalogue or version string does not.

areas.claude: The owner can select the main session or an available isolated implementer. Only the main session merges.
areas.codex: The owner selected this main Codex session; it created, committed and pushed this audit branch.
areas.operator_action: Write RUN-NOTES.md without overwriting inherited notes, commit/push each meaningful step, open a PR. A question alone does not authorize edits.

areas.claude: Use the native backend with --reviewer claude-sonnet --variant medium for this owner selection. No default change. Live review outcome and receipt are attached to the PR after this snapshot.
areas.codex: Codex main plus native Claude is an allowed route in the current runner. T60 live MiniMax review also demonstrated the existing route from Codex.
areas.operator_action: Record the selection, pin the PR head in a full brief, run the chosen reviewer once, inspect the full final and denials. Identity/coverage/DW holds remain mandatory. No live Claude result is claimed by this pre-review snapshot.
areas.alternative_or_limit: Use the current Codex main plus native Claude route; this snapshot does not assert its later verdict.

areas.claude: Reviewers return findings; the trusted parent posts and labels. Approving review and green CI precede merge.
areas.codex: T60 Codex main opened PR #269, relayed the full M3 review and merged the exact approved head after CI and rerun. Current scripts share the poster.
areas.operator_action: Use gh from the parent only for authorized publication. The current audit has not tested every client as a publisher; shared poster tests and the T60 run establish the described route.

areas.claude: Local original-game access is subject to rules 18–24 and permitted API routes. Native CLI does not itself make a session local or safe for originals.
areas.codex: The connected host has static and E019 capture directories. This audit probes existence only; it does not run the game or inspect originals.
areas.operator_action: Keep binaries/assets/saves/captures/derived code under their stated boundaries. Static first; local captures via the responsible main session. Do not transfer them to cloud or malpaco.
areas.alternative_or_limit: Only directory existence was checked; original-game access and Wine readiness need separate authorized checks.

areas.claude: Session-start hook is web-only, not this SSH preflight; its metadata defects are #271. No live web runtime tested.
areas.codex: This is an SSH-connected local host, not evidence of a cloud environment. No cloud originals/runtime tested.
areas.operator_action: Perform clean cloud-only checks separately, without originals. Do not run the install-capable web hook as a local smoke test.
areas.alternative_or_limit: No clean cloud session was exercised; retain the local path and prohibit uploading originals there.

areas.claude: Current runtime rejects a same-family reviewer even when explicitly owner-selected, contrary to rule 6.3.
areas.codex: Retained probes directly show OpenAI same-family rejection from Codex, Claude same-family rejection from Claude, and a synthetic blocked-list refusal.
areas.operator_action: Until #270 lands, use a genuinely allowed alternative selected by the owner or the permitted external reviewer/post-review route with honest identity metadata. Do not alter family markers or claim the runner supports unrestricted choices.
areas.alternative_or_limit: Use an honestly identified owner-selected alternative route; unrestricted native same-family dispatch needs the separate fix.

revision_note: R2 addresses native Sonnet review R1–R7. Original R1 artifacts are retained unchanged, not silently replaced.
